description.p: ROS-Industrial support for the KUKA KR 1250 (and variants).
This package contains configuration data, 3D models and launch files for KUKA KR 1250 manipulators. This currently includes the R3700-2 F.

Joint limits and maximum joint velocities of KR1250 R3700-2F are based on the information found in the online datasheet 0000-470-278 / V1.2 / 26.02.2026. All urdfs are based on the default motion and joint velocity limits, unless noted otherwise.
Before using any of the configuration files and / or meshes included in this package, be sure to check they are correct for the particular robot model and configuration you intend to use them with.
